title: “Fraud prevention” wants a test payment
scenario: A bank security caller says your treasury account was targeted and asks you to make a $1 test transfer to a new beneficiary so they can confirm that transaction controls are working.

answers.A: Lock/highly restrict outgoing payments while independently verifying the alert.
answers.B: Send the $1 because the amount is negligible and can confirm whether the caller is truly watching the account.
answers.C: Do not make the transfer; contact the bank through the treasury portal or known relationship manager.

explanation: A test payment only proves the destination received your money. It does not authenticate the caller and may establish a beneficiary for later fraud.
